t: Tracer 200mm deep hole construction pencil set designed as an all-purpose marking tool for trade professionals on building sites and in workshops. The set includes 6 x 2.8mm 2B extendable graphite leads, an anti-snap lead dispenser, and a durable site holster with an inbuilt sharpener for convenience and longevity. The pencil features an extendable lead mechanism, ideal for joinery, plumbing, and electrical installations where precision marking in confined spaces is essential. Marks up to 100mm deep in a 3mm width hole and up to 145mm deep in a 6mm width hole, ensuring accurate results in difficult-to-reach areas.
b: Marks up to 145mm Deep in 6mm Holes
Durable Site Holster for Storage & Access
